name: eyeWalker
description: Deterministic mock interface for evaluating obstacle-cue presentation. No image model, live detector, navigation system, or spatial-audio renderer is executed.
author: NeuroAgent AI
license: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 by default; MIT only for exact DUAL_LICENSE.md allowlist paths

image.description: Interface input used only to seed or display a mock; pixels are not analyzed by a model

mock_location.description: Optional synthetic display context; not live GPS or ground truth

simulated_obstacles.description: Deterministic synthetic records, each marked simulated; not detections

simulated_cue.description: Locally derived interface text beginning SIMULATED RESEARCH CUE and ending with the mobility-aid safety suffix

output.simulated_cue: SIMULATED RESEARCH CUE: TRASH BIN 2.1m ahead (bearing -20 degrees), step right 0.5m. Keep your cane or guide dog. Not a medical device.

privacy.posture: Prefer local processing and require explicit consent before any future remote path
privacy.nemoclaw_status: Unimplemented, unvalidated, unenforced policy sketch only

safety: SIMULATED RESEARCH ONLY. Keep your cane or guide dog. Not a medical device. Not for navigation, clinical, diagnostic, production, or regulatory use.
